analyst_view.overall: Early view: Go Ahead host Twente four days before Twente's Conference League trip to AGF in Denmark. Go Ahead's last two wins were both 1-0 with Mats Tengstedt scoring and Jasper Cillessen keeping clean sheets, though they also lost 4-0 at Cambuur in a game later abandoned; Twente have scored heavily all autumn.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. I lean a little lower: Go Ahead's home games with Cillessen in goal have been tight, and Twente may rotate before AGF.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.3 corners, Twente taking most. Twente's crossing game with Weghorst fits that; I keep it.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.4 cards. Both teams are fairly disciplined and there is no rivalry or ban news; I keep the low figure.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.5 shots, 20 of them Twente's. That is a lot for an away side, but Twente have been dominant, so I agree.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.8 shots on target. Cillessen's form and a deep Go Ahead defence that blocks shots suggest a little less.
